answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A harbor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ledge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
